ValidationRule.description: 當Transportation = Use STARLUX-provided chauffeur service (使用星宇航空提供之接送機服務)，【Canlead / Hertz Order No.】為必填
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name = "Private Terminal Service", ISPICKVAL(Transportation__c, "Use STARLUX-provided chauffeur service"), ISBLANK(Canlead_Hertz_Order_No__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When the Transportation = Use STARLUX-provided chauffeur service, the【Canlead / Hertz Order No.】can't be empty.
